name: Gilten
summary: Austrian four-player partnership trick-taking game with 32 Tell cards and betting on melds and trick majority.
rules_text: Four players in two fixed partnerships use a 32-card German Tell pack. 5 cards are dealt to each, next card turned for trump. Aim is first team to 11 or 15 table points. Three figures score: Gleich = two or more equal ranks in one hand, Hanger = two+ consecutive cards of same suit in one hand, Spiel = taking at least three of five tricks. Better length then rank wins Gleich/Hanger; ties score nothing. Trick play clockwise: follow suit or play trump always allowed; if void any card; highest trump or highest led suit wins. After deal teams may alternately bet on any figure, raising its value from 1 up to 7, then Game Out to win match. Opponents may accept with good / hold or raise. When Spiel is decided, tricks stop; undecided Gleich/Hanger are shown, Spiel winner showing first, matching opponent's shown or bet quantity.
rating_reason: Partnership trick-taking with betting, fits numeric bids.
